title: Status bar
description: Bottom status bar (28px) with left and right item groups.
usage: Bottom of a full-window layout. Children: <vsc-status-item>s in visual order; align="right" items go to the right group.

examples.title: Editing a JSON file
examples.html: <vsc-statusbar><vsc-status-item text="$(remote)" label="remote"></vsc-status-item><vsc-status-item text="$(error) 0 $(warning) 0" label="No Problems"></vsc-status-item><vsc-status-item align="right" text="Ln 2, Col 1"></vsc-status-item><vsc-status-item align="right" text="Spaces: 4"></vsc-status-item><vsc-status-item align="right" text="UTF-8"></vsc-status-item><vsc-status-item align="right" text="LF"></vsc-status-item><vsc-status-item align="right" compact="right" text="$(bracket)" label="Editor Language Status"></vsc-status-item><vsc-status-item align="right" compact="left" text="JSON"></vsc-status-item><vsc-status-item align="right" text="$(copilot)" label="Copilot status"></vsc-status-item><vsc-status-item align="right" text="Layout: us"></vsc-status-item><vsc-status-item align="right" text="$(bell)" label="Notifications"></vsc-status-item></vsc-statusbar>
